sources.title: baerquants/Inkling-Small-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 1. General Information Inkling-Small is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text, image and audio inputs and generates text outputs. It is intended for use in English and other languages, and across multiple coding languages. The model is designed to be used by developers building AI-powered applications, including agentic and tool-use systems, coding assistants, chatbots, and ...
